config.pages.base_game.title: Base Game & Engine
config.pages.base_game.desc: Core engine optimizations targeting rendering draw calls, garbage collection, memory reduction, and co-op network throughput.
config.pages.mod_patches.title: Third-Party Mods
config.pages.mod_patches.desc: Performance patches for third-party SMAPI mods. Optimizations automatically sleep if the corresponding mod is not installed.
config.pages.diagnostics.title: Profiling & Diagnostics

module.CameraSmoothing.name: Camera Subpixel Smoothing
module.CameraSmoothing.desc: Applies subpixel floating-point interpolation to the camera viewport to eliminate stutter.
config.CameraSmoothing.EnableCameraSmoot: Smooths camera movement, especially noticeable on high refresh displays.
module.VegetationFrustumCulling.name: Vegetation & Crop Frustum Culling
module.VegetationFrustumCulling.desc: Culls off-screen draw calls for crops, giant crops, trees, bushes, and grass.
config.VegetationFrustumCulling.desc: Skips off-screen draw calls for crops, grass, trees, and bushes on large farms, reducing GPU draw submissions and CPU loop overhead.
config.VegetationFrustumCulling.EnableVe: Skips rendering off-screen crops, grass tufts, trees, and bushes outside the viewport.
config.VegetationFrustumCulling.Vegetati: Safety margin in pixels beyond the viewport edge before culling kicks in (default: 128 px = 2 tiles; trees automatically receive an extra 128 px top margin).
module.FurnitureFrustumCulling.name: Furniture Frustum Culling
module.FurnitureFrustumCulling.desc: Culls off-screen draw calls for indoor and outdoor furniture.
config.FurnitureFrustumCulling.EnableFur: Skips rendering furniture that is completely outside the active screen.
module.AnimalFrustumCulling.name: Farm Animal Frustum Culling
module.AnimalFrustumCulling.desc: Culls off-screen draw calls for farm animals.
config.AnimalFrustumCulling.EnableAnimal: Skips rendering farm animals located outside the screen view.
module.LightingOptimization.name: Lighting Optimization
module.LightingOptimization.desc: Culls off-screen light sources and optimizes light cleanup.
config.LightingOptimization.EnableLightC: Skips rendering light sources that are completely off-screen.
Optimizes end-of-day light source disposal to prevent stutter.
module.MapLayerOptimization.name: Sparse Map Layer Draw Culling
module.MapLayerOptimization.desc: Bypasses tile draw loops for empty or out-of-bounds map layers.
config.MapLayerOptimization.EnableLayerC: Skips drawing map layers with zero visible tiles on screen.
module.CoopNetworkOptimization.name: Asymmetric Co-op Network Optimizer
module.CoopNetworkOptimization.desc: Expands UDP socket buffers to prevent packet drops in multiplayer.
config.CoopNetworkOptimization.EnableCoo: Increases network socket buffer sizes for smoother co-op play.
config.CoopNetworkOptimization.CoopSocke: Size of UDP socket buffer in kilobytes (default: 1024 KB = 1 MB).
module.LowLatencyGC.name: Low-Latency GC Scheduler
module.LowLatencyGC.desc: Reduces GC pause frequency during active gameplay by managing .NET GC latency modes.
config.LowLatencyGC.desc: Configures .NET SustainedLowLatency GC mode during active gameplay to defer Gen 2 collections to screen fades and transitions.
config.LowLatencyGC.EnableLowLatencyGC.t: Suppresses blocking Gen 2 GC sweeps during active gameplay.
config.LowLatencyGC.EnableTransitionComp: Triggers a non-blocking background garbage collection on a worker thread when transitioning between days.
module.MemoryOptimization.name: Universal Memory Reduction
module.MemoryOptimization.desc: Reduces RAM and VRAM footprint through texture cache management, SinZational Speedy Solutions LRU bounding, and cross-platform memory reclamation.
config.MemoryOptimization.EnableMemoryOp: Master toggle for memory reduction features.
Prioritizes aggressive memory reduction for 8GB MacBooks, laptops, and handhelds (automatically limits texture caches to 256 MB).
config.MemoryOptimization.MaxTextureCach: Maximum megabytes of raw decoded textures held in CPU memory (0 = Unbounded; adaptive 1.5-8 GB based on system RAM to eliminate thrashing).
config.MemoryOptimization.ManageSinZCach: Caps and evicts excess memory from SinZational Speedy Solutions's texture cache using LRU eviction to prevent runaway memory usage.
config.MemoryOptimization.TrimOnWarp.too: Runs non-blocking background cleanup after changing locations to help keep working set lean.
config.MemoryOptimization.PeriodicTrimMi: How often to automatically run background memory cleanup during gameplay (0 = Disabled).
config.MemoryOptimization.PurgeTexturesO: Purges CPU texture buffers during morning day transitions when textures are already loaded on the GPU.
config.MemoryOptimization.AutoTrimWorkin: Runs non-blocking background garbage collection and memory reclamation each morning.
config.MemoryOptimization.TrimExternalIm: Trims large texture caches in third-party mods like SinZational Speedy Solutions.
module.SaveStream.name: High-Throughput Save Stream
module.SaveStream.desc: Reuses save serialization streams across in-game days to eliminate Large Object Heap re-allocations and speed up end-of-day saves.
config.SaveStream.desc: Reduces the end-of-day 'Saving...' screen delay by reusing serialization streams across days, preventing repeated Large Object Heap garbage collections.
config.SaveStream.EnableSaveStreamOptimi: Reuses the save memory buffer across saves instead of repeatedly allocating and resizing 1 KB streams up to 20+ MB on the Large Object Heap.
module.TenMinuteClockOptimization.name: 10-Minute Clock Smoothing & Synchronous Math
module.TenMinuteClockOptimization.desc: Eliminates hitching every 10 in-game minutes by optimizing distance calculations and pass-time loops.
config.TenMinuteClockOptimization.desc: Reduces 10-minute clock tick overhead through granular mathematical and collection optimizations.
config.TenMinuteClockOptimization.Enable: Skips object and animal iterations on locations with zero objects or animals during 10-minute clock ticks.
Skips calling minutesElapsed on inert base objects (weeds, stones, paths, torches) during 10-minute updates, eliminating massive Harmony hook dispatch.
Replaces LINQ enumerator allocations and square roots with squared Euclidean distance when finding nearby NPCs.
Replaces FishingRod.distanceToLand list allocations with a zero-allocation border scan.
module.StringOptimization.name: Global String Pooling & Time Memoization
module.StringOptimization.desc: Reduces garbage collection pressure from repeated string parsing and game clock formatting.
config.StringOptimization.desc: Optimizes ArgUtility and clock time queries to reduce transient string allocations.
config.StringOptimization.EnableStringPo: Extracts indexed arguments directly via spans without allocating intermediate string arrays.
config.StringOptimization.EnableTimeStri: Memoizes localized game clock time strings to reduce allocations from HUD queries.
module.LocationUpdateOptimization.name: Off-Screen Location Update Allocation Fix
module.LocationUpdateOptimization.desc: Eliminates temporary list allocations during location update passes.
config.LocationUpdateOptimization.Enable: Reuses pooled entity arrays during location updates to eliminate Gen 0 GC garbage.
module.SpatialCollision.name: Spatial Collision Fast-Reject
module.SpatialCollision.desc: Accelerates collision detection for buildings, furniture, and NPCs using integer bounding box fast-rejection.
config.SpatialCollision.desc: Accelerates movement and collision detection by fast-rejecting distant building and furniture checks.
config.SpatialCollision.EnableBuildingCo: Fast-rejects distant farm building collision checks using simple rectangle arithmetic before calling virtual NetField methods.
config.SpatialCollision.EnableFurnitureC: Fast-rejects distant furniture collision checks using exact bounding box intersection without virtual calls.
config.SpatialCollision.EnableSpatialCol: Caches immutable bounding boxes for resource clumps and bushes during movement.
config.SpatialCollision.EnableNpcBuildin: Skips redundant marital checks when NPCs walk outdoors on active schedules. 100% vanilla and polyamory mod compatible.
module.MapLoadOptimization.name: Fast Map Load & Tile Cache
module.MapLoadOptimization.desc: Caches tile properties and accelerates map load parsing.
config.MapLoadOptimization.EnableFastMap: Accelerates tmx/xnb map loading by caching parsed tile properties.
module.InitialLoadOptimization.name: Initial Game Load Times
module.InitialLoadOptimization.desc: Speeds up initial game startup via parallel image decoding and data pre-warming.
config.InitialLoadOptimization.EnablePar: Decodes modded PNG textures in parallel across all CPU cores during launch.
config.InitialLoadOptimization.EnablePre: Pre-warms SMAPI content caches to reduce first-load stutter.
module.RemoteLocationCulling.name: Remote Empty Location Culling
module.RemoteLocationCulling.desc: Staggers background 60 Hz updates to 15 Hz for locations with no active players, preserving all machines, crops, and clock events.
config.RemoteLocationCulling.EnableRemot: Reduces update frequency for maps where no players are present.
module.NPCFrustumThrottling.name: NPC Viewport Frustum Throttling
module.NPCFrustumThrottling.desc: Throttles off-screen villager pathfinding from 60Hz to 15Hz while keeping nearby villagers 100% smooth.
config.NPCFrustumThrottling.desc: Throttles off-screen villager pathfinding from 60Hz to 15Hz in large towns (like SVE Pelican Town or Ridgeside).
config.NPCFrustumThrottling.EnableNPCFru: Throttles distant off-screen NPCs to 15Hz. Automatically runs at full 60Hz when nearby, walking on schedules, in cutscenes, or in multiplayer.
module.SMAPIReflectionOptimization.name: SMAPI Fast Render Check Optimizer
module.SMAPIReflectionOptimization.desc: Caches SMAPI mod render check reflections to eliminate delegate dispatch overhead.
config.SMAPIReflectionOptimization.Enabl: Accelerates SMAPI's internal per-frame event dispatching.
module.ScheduleOptimization.name: NPC Schedule & Pathfinding Optimizer
module.ScheduleOptimization.desc: Memoizes NPC route calculations to prevent morning frame drops.
config.ScheduleOptimization.EnableSchedu: Memoizes schedule path parsing to eliminate morning NPC route hitching.
module.ItemQueryOptimization.name: Item Query & ALL_ITEMS Optimizer
module.ItemQueryOptimization.desc: Caches item definitions to speed up shop menus, crafting lists, and custom item lookups.
config.ItemQueryOptimization.EnableItemQ: Caches parsed ItemQuery expressions used by shops, quests, and modded craftables.
module.ContentPatcherOptimization.name: Content Patcher Engine Optimization
module.ContentPatcherOptimization.desc: Optimizes token evaluation and texture patching passes in Content Patcher.
config.ContentPatcherOptimization.desc: Deduplicates redundant patch updates and accelerates token parsing across 500+ CP packs.
config.ContentPatcherOptimization.Enable: Optimizes token parsing and patch evaluation in Content Patcher.
module.NPCMapLocationsOptimization.name: NPC Map Locations Throttling
module.NPCMapLocationsOptimization.desc: Throttles background minimap marker calculations to reduce CPU usage.
config.NPCMapLocationsOptimization.secti: Third-Party Mod Optimizations: NPC Map Locations
config.NPCMapLocationsOptimization.Enabl: Limits minimap NPC marker recalculations from 60 Hz down to configured rate.
config.NPCMapLocationsOptimization.NPCMa: How many times per second to recalculate NPC minimap markers (default: 2 Hz).
module.UIInfoSuite2Optimization.name: UI Info Suite 2 Buff Reflection Fast-Path
module.UIInfoSuite2Optimization.desc: Replaces reflection in UI Info Suite 2 buff rendering with direct field access.
config.UIInfoSuite2Optimization.EnableUI: Replaces reflection in buff timer drawing with direct access.
module.BetterGameMenuRSVCompat.name: Better Game Menu & Ridgeside Village Compat
module.BetterGameMenuRSVCompat.desc: Prevents menu crash when using Better Game Menu alongside Ridgeside Village.
config.BetterGameMenuRSVCompat.section: Third-Party Mod Optimizations: Better Game Menu & RSV
config.BetterGameMenuRSVCompat.EnableRSV: Enable RSV & Better Game Menu Fix
Fixes menu layout conflicts and crashes when Ridgeside Village and Better Game Menu are both active.
module.AlternativeTexturesOptimization.d: Throttles seasonal skin lookups and bypasses inactive entities.
config.AlternativeTexturesOptimization.d: Optimizes Alternative Textures by throttling season/texture variation polling from 60 Hz to 1 Hz, and bypassing monsters in empty locations.
config.AlternativeTexturesOptimization.E: Reduces CPU overhead by throttling season texture updates to 1 Hz and bypassing monsters in inactive locations.
module.FTMOptimization.name: Farm Type Manager (FTM) Spike Fast-Reject
module.FTMOptimization.desc: Prevents spawn lag spikes on day start in Farm Type Manager.
config.FTMOptimization.section: Third-Party Mod Optimizations: Farm Type Manager
config.FTMOptimization.EnableFTMOptimiza: Caches location validity checks to eliminate day-start stutter with large FTM pack setups.
module.DynamicReflectionsOptimization.de: Culls off-screen reflection calculations and water draw passes.
config.DynamicReflectionsOptimization.En: Skips reflection passes for objects and characters outside the viewport.
Suppresses reflection render target creation when no water tiles are visible on screen.
module.DaLionOptimization.name: Walk of Life / DaLion Perks Optimization
module.DaLionOptimization.desc: Optimizes perk evaluation and auto-grabber polling.
config.DaLionOptimization.section: Third-Party Mod Optimizations: Walk of Life / DaLion
config.DaLionOptimization.EnableDaLionOp: Caches perk bonuses to avoid recalculating stats every frame.
module.CloudySkiesOptimization.name: Cloudy Skies Indoor Draw Culling
module.CloudySkiesOptimization.desc: Suppresses cloud rendering passes when the player is inside buildings.
config.CloudySkiesOptimization.EnableClo: Completely skips cloud layer updates and draw calls when indoors.
module.MovementOverhaulOptimization.name: Movement Overhaul Off-Screen Physics Culling
module.MovementOverhaulOptimization.desc: Suppresses diagonal speed and friction physics for off-screen characters.
config.MovementOverhaulOptimization.Enab: Bypasses sub-tile friction simulation for characters far outside the camera.
module.SpaceCoreSaveOptimization.name: SpaceCore Save Serialization Fast-Path
module.SpaceCoreSaveOptimization.desc: Optimizes SpaceCore's XML save walk using iterative pooled scanning and branch pruning to speed up saving.
config.SpaceCoreSaveOptimization.EnableS: Replaces SpaceCore's recursive XML save walk with an iterative pooled scanner with branch pruning.
Bypasses array allocation and buffer rental for XML elements with 1 or 2 children during save serialization.
module.CustomCompanionsOptimization.name: Custom Companions World-Scan Fast-Reject
module.CustomCompanionsOptimization.desc: Accelerates companion target scans using spatial distance partitioning.
config.CustomCompanionsOptimization.Enab: Bypasses broad-phase location sweeps for companions that are following the player.
module.HelpWantedOptimization.name: Help Wanted Performance Suite
module.HelpWantedOptimization.desc: Accelerates billboard quest generation and item availability checks.
config.HelpWantedOptimization.EnableHelp: Caches random item lookups during billboard quest generation.
module.TMXTilePropertyOptimization.name: TMX Map Tile String Optimizer
module.TMXTilePropertyOptimization.desc: Omits default zero-value '@Rotation' and '@Flip' property entries when loading maps.
config.TMXTilePropertyOptimization.desc: Omits default zero-value '@Rotation' and '@Flip' property entries when loading maps.
config.TMXTilePropertyOptimization.Enabl: Eliminates tens of thousands of duplicate empty string property allocations per loaded map.
module.QuestJournalOptimization.name: Quest Journal Throttling Optimizer
module.QuestJournalOptimization.desc: Throttles background quest objective evaluation when journal menu is closed.
config.QuestJournalOptimization.EnableQu: Evaluates complex quest conditions on tick intervals rather than every single draw frame.
module.OrnithologistsGuildOptimization.d: Bypasses ConditionalWeakTable lock sweeps and ModData parsing for trees without nests, eliminating frame drops in heavily wooded areas.
config.OrnithologistsGuildOptimization.E: Skips table lock contention and ModData scans for trees without nests, eliminating micro-stutters in forest areas.
module.FashionSenseOptimization.name: Fashion Sense Fast Appearance Lookup
module.FashionSenseOptimization.desc: Replaces linear FirstOrDefault scans in Fashion Sense with instant O(1) dictionary lookups, eliminating closure garbage collection.
config.FashionSenseOptimization.EnableFa: Accelerates clothing and hair rendering by replacing linear pack scans with instant dictionary lookups.
module.NatureInTheValleyOptimization.nam: Nature in the Valley Asset Memoization
module.NatureInTheValleyOptimization.des: Memoizes creature indicator icons and accelerates inventory category filters, avoiding synchronous disk reloads on every frame.
config.NatureInTheValleyOptimization.sec: Third-Party Mod Optimizations: Nature in the Valley
config.NatureInTheValleyOptimization.Ena: Memoizes creature indicator textures and accelerates inventory scanning.
module.DynamicMapTilesOptimization.name: Dynamic Map Tiles Barrier Fast-Path
module.DynamicMapTilesOptimization.desc: Caches barrier type lookups and avoids reflection allocations during movement collision checks.
config.DynamicMapTilesOptimization.secti: Third-Party Mod Optimizations: Dynamic Map Tiles Extended
config.DynamicMapTilesOptimization.Enabl: Caches character barrier type queries and eliminates reflection overhead during tile collisions.
module.AutomateOptimization.name: Automate Empty Location Fast-Reject
module.AutomateOptimization.desc: Bypasses 20,000-tile flood-fill searches in Automate on empty maps containing zero chests, machines, or terrain features.
config.AutomateOptimization.EnableAutoma: Bypasses 20,000-tile flood-fill searches in Automate on empty maps with zero objects, buildings, or terrain features.
module.GMCMOptimization.name: GMCM Gameplay Guard
module.GMCMOptimization.desc: Eliminates redundant 60 Hz title menu reflection and container polling in GMCM during active gameplay.
config.GMCMOptimization.section: Third-Party Mod Optimizations: Generic Mod Config Menu
config.GMCMOptimization.EnableGMCMOptimi: Eliminates redundant 60 Hz title menu reflection in GMCM while walking around in-game.
module.LiveDiagnostics.name: Live Profiling & Behavior Diagnostics
module.LiveDiagnostics.desc: Provides real-time profiling, frame telemetry, and performance metrics.
config.LiveDiagnostics.EnableLiveDiagnos: Enables periodic console diagnostic metrics and live performance monitoring.
config.LiveDiagnostics.DiagnosticsInterv: How frequently to log memory, culling, and GC metrics to the SMAPI console.
